message.title: Solstad Offshore ASA: Invitation to Webcast - Presentation of Third Quarter 2026 Results
message.body:
Skudeneshavn, 28 October 2026

Solstad Offshore ASA (SOFF) is pleased to invite you to a live webcast
presentation of the company's third quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, November
4, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CEST.

The presentation will be held by CEO Lars Peder Solstad and CFO Kjetil Ramstad
and will include a Q&A session. The presentation will be released at 07:00 a.m.
CEST on the same day and made available at www.solstad.com and www.newsweb.no.

SOFF Third Quarter 2026 Presentation:

Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026
Time: 10:00 a.m. CEST
Format: Live webcast
